title: Deckle
summary: A dependency-free writing surface that behaves like a pad of handmade paper, with tactile ink, a corner you can turn, and drawings you can share as a link.
description: A four-file browser experiment in paper texture, paginated writing, drawing, print behavior, and deliberately physical interaction design.
highlights: Builds paper grain, fibers, flecks, ink, and deckled edges without image dependencies.
Turns the page with a draggable corner peel built from clip-paths, so every blend mode and filter survives the fold.
Supports pens, pencil, highlighting, erasing, undo/redo, persistence, print output, and sharing a drawing as a link, PNG, or file.
Runs directly from static files, published to GitHub Pages, with a zero-dependency live-reload server and node:test suite.

services.label: Deckle live-reload server
services.description: Serves the paper surface with live reload on a port reserved by the portfolio.
